You might want to steady the ladder before you start climbing.|Blevin|}} '''Blevin''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]] and served as a [[ISB Supervisor|supervisor]] in the [[Imperial Security Bureau]]'s [[Investigations]] detachment during the [[Imperial Era]]. Following the [[Ambush on Ferrix|Ferrix incident]], Blevin participated in a meeting of ISB supervisors led by [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz|Partagaz]], and reported on the incident and was tasked with [[Galactic Empire]] [[Takeover of the Preox-Morlana Corporate Sector|revoking]] [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] corporative independence. Blevin was trusted with the supervision of six different [[sector]]s as well as the supervision of [[senator]] [[Mon Mothma]], acting as the handler of deep undercover agent [[Exmar Kloris|Kloris]] who was posing as her personal [[driver]]. Partagaz viewed him as a capable member of the ISB. ==Biography== ===Meeting agenda=== {{Quote|Blevin, Morlana sector. This incident on Ferrix.''"
"''Corporate Security, sir. They're still in charge out there. They tried to serve a warrant and ran into more trouble than they'd anticipated.|Partagaz and Blevin|}} [[File:LieutenantSupervisorBlevin-ToppsSW2023.png|thumb|220px|right|ISB Supervisor, Lieutenant Blevin]] During the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[human]] [[Gender|male]] Blevin served the Empire's [[Imperial Security Bureau]] (ISB), rising to the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]]{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} within the [[Investigations]] branch.''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' He was the [[ISB Supervisor]] of six different [[sector]]s, including the [[Free Trade sector|Morlana sector]]. In [[5 BBY]], there was an [[Ambush on Ferrix|incident]] on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]], part of the Morlana sector, where the local [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|Corporate Security]] had sustained multiple [[death]]s and killed a [[Timm Karlo|civilian]] in a failed attempt to serve a warrant on the suspected murderer [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]].{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}} Being informed of the incident, Blevin gathered various details on what happened on Ferrix and put it among the items for an upcoming summit with the other ISB supervisors and their superior, [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz|Partagaz]]. At the meeting Partagaz went through items with the supervisors before asking Blevin about the Ferrix incident. The lieutenant supervisor summarized what he knew on the matter, mentioning the deaths and damage as well as a stolen [[Imperial N-S9 Starpath Unit]] that was recovered by an [[ensign]] at the scene. Partagaz asked who was responsible, to which Blevin replied that the perpetrator was unknown and informed the major that he would be leaving to investigate more after the meeting. Blevin's superior then told him they would speak before he left. ===Imperial takeover=== {{Quote|It took the combined ingredients of idiocy, ineptitude, and total disengagement for this farce to have reached the full apex of incredulous disaster. ''[…]'' My files are filled with Corporate Security fiascos, but this takes the prize.|Blevin scolds Hyne, Syril Karn, and Linus Mosk|}} After speaking with Partagaz, Blevin made his way to the planet [[Morlana One]], where the [[Corporate Security Headquarters]] was located. There the Empire had taken over the company and was clearing out the headquarters and redirecting its personnel. The supervisor pulled aside [[Chief Inspector]] [[Hyne]] at the latter's office as well as [[Deputy Inspector]] [[Syril Karn]], who had begun the mission to Ferrix against Hyne's orders, and [[Sergeant]] [[Linus Mosk]], who co-led the team of [[Tac-Corpo|corpos]] that was deployed to arrest Andor. Blevin gave orders to the three officers to relinquish all of their [[comlink]]s, weapons, and [[scandoc]]s and be escorted to a transfer center to be issued with any inventoried personal items. [[File:Syril-decomissioned.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Blevin confronts Syril Karn and his associates in the Corporate Security.]] Continuing, the supervisor told the trio to holo-certify receipt of items as well as confirmation of the ISB After Action Report which detailed their involvement and culpability in the Ferrix incident. Hyne attempted to raise a question, only for the supervisor to shut him down, adding that three officers would not waste Imperial time by reading the reports. The chief inspector argued that he was not involved in the Ferrix incident, only for Blevin to sarcastically agree. Going up to the officers, the supervisor berated their idiocy around the incident, responding with disdain when Mosk raised his hand. Turning to Karn, he sardonically congratulated the deputy inspector on causing the end of Corporate independence. ===Conflict of interest=== {{Quote|She's demanding the raw data from the incident on Ferrix.''"
"''The Starpath unit that was recovered at the scene has been traced to a theft at an air base under my jurisdiction, sir.''"
"''She's overreaching to increase the size of her portfolio. She should spend more time on the security at her bases and less furthering her career.|Blevin and Dedra Meero make their cases to Partagaz|}} Meanwhile, Lieutenant Supervisor [[Dedra Meero]], a newer addition to her role, had taken interest in the Starpath Unit that had been recovered on Ferrix, linking it to one stolen from the [[Steergard Naval Yard]], which was under her jurisdiction. She sent her [[aide]], [[ISB Attendant]] [[Avril Heert]] to request for all information on Ferrix from Blevin's office. Upon receiving the request, though, Blevin denied it. As a result, Meero went to [[Blevin's office|his office]] to address the matter with him herself. Blevin responded that he had work to do and suggested she made an appointment. After Blevin argued that Ferrix was in his sector and not Meero's, his colleague asserted that she had jurisdictional access as a Starpath Unit stolen from one of her sectors was part of the case. Blevin accused Meero of trying to insert herself into his case to further her career. After he confirmed that he was denying her request, she told him that she would take the matter to Partagaz. [[File:ISBCrossfire-Andor4.png|thumb|right|300px|Blevin and Dedra Meero meet with Partagaz.]] Blevin and Meero met with Partagaz in the meeting chamber, where the latter continued to argue that she had jurisdictional access while her colleague brushed it off as her wanting to increase her portfolio, suggesting she spent more time on the security at her own bases. Meero believed the theft from the Steergard Naval Yard was linked to rebel activity referencing other cases that she believed were linked by the similarity in the methods and what was stolen. Partagaz, though, did not think the information was definite enough to call the incidents rebel activity, advising her that she stayed to her sector. The major thus dismissed Blevin, who cracked a smirk at having put Meero in her place as he left the room. ===Operations=== {{Quote|I was asking if this would do as your headquarters.''"
"''Could I be made Prefect? The title. I know it doesn't come with extra pay.''"
"''You can wear a ball gown if you'd like. Just get this up and running before my next staff meeting.|Blevin and Vanis Tigo|{{Andor|The Axe Forgets}}}} [[File:Blevin-on-Ferrix.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Blevin stands besides the repairs at Rix Road on Ferrix.]] Blevin made his way to Ferrix, where the Empire was establishing its presence at the resident [[city]] and tending to the damages from the incident with the local workers. While he watched repair work on the city's [[Rix Road]], the Imperial [[Captain]] [[Vanis Tigo]] was rushing residents out of a hotel. The supervisor called his associate over, asking if the hotel would do as a headquarters. The captain, though, decided to ask for a promotion to [[Prefect]], brushing off the fact it had no pay rise. Blevin sarcastically told Tigo that the latter could wear a ball gown if he would like to and told his colleague to get the headquarters up and running before the supervisor's next staff meeting. He thus parted with the captain, walking down Rix Road. After returning to the ISB headquarters, Blevin asked a group of his attendants for [[Standard week|weekly]] reports on the situation of Ferrix and a budget adjustment. When he asked about the news in his absence, an attendant mentioned the [[Finkly Conference]] and how they had agreed to move up Blevin's speech. Shortly afterwards, an [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|infiltration team]] conducted a successful [[Aldhani heist|heist]] at an [[Aldhani dam|Imperial installation]] on the [[planet]] [[Aldhani]] where they stole around eighty million [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] from a vault containing the entire [[sector]]'s payroll. As a result of the theft, Partagaz hailed the supervisors and other staff to the meeting chamber. Blevin stood with the other assembled staff as the major ordered for every [[Star Sector and Planetary Emergency Retaliation plan]] in the building to be ready for presentation by midnight.{{Andor|The Eye}} ===Dispute with Meero=== [[File:BlevinAccusesMeero-Announcement.png|thumb|300px|right|Blevin accused Meero of breaking regulations in front of the entire supervisors' forum.]] Following the incident on Aldhani, [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] personally granted additional powers to the ISB to more effectively reinforce the Empire's security. Dedra Meero used these emergency powers to request a Multi-Sector Data Blend from the ISB's datatape vault, which effectively provided her with data from sectors outside of her jurisdiction, including Blevin's. Blevin brought this up during a supervisors' forum session, remarking that Meero's actions were against Imperial regulations. Partagaz allowed Meero a chance to explain herself to which she responded by revealing that she had used the blend to collect tangible material evidence of a pattern between thefts of Imperial equipment across multiple sectors. She further refuted that her colleagues were naive to believe that the rebels would confine their activities to their respective sectors that Partagaz had created. She then mentioned she had a documented file proving the existence of a larger rebel movement that Blevin was aware of and suggested that his accusations were out of self-preservation than "sense of urgency." Blevin confidently insisted that dealing with a rogue intelligence officer was the more concerning issue to keep anyone else in the ISB from playing loose with the rules like her. Partagaz seemed to agree with him, prompting Blevin to assume he had won the argument, only for Partagaz to express his admiration for Meero's endeavour and chose to remove the Morlana sector from Blevin's jurisdiction and reassign it to Meero, as he deemed it a "distraction" to Blevin. ===Investigating Mon Mothma=== [[File:BlevinKloris-RixRoad.png|thumb|250px|left|Blevin listens to a report from Kloris, an ISB plant as Mon Mothma's driver.]] Blevin was later briefed by [[Exmar Kloris|Kloris]], the driver of [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] who had been planted as a [[spy]]. Kloris reported an argument he overheard between Mothma and her husband, [[Perrin Fertha]], word for word on the latter's alleged gambling debts. Blevin then wondered if Mothma was mad about Fertha lying or the possibility of gambling debts. He then came to the conclusion that Kloris' report could be beneficial to the ISB, as it could account for the discrepancies in Mothma's official banking accounts, with Kloris suggesting that Fertha's gambling debts were a repeated matter.{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} Unbeknownst to both men, Mothma was aware of Kloris' double agent status and was purposely feeding misinformation to cover for her banking irregularities used to fund the [[Axis network]].{{Andor|Nobody's Listening}} The briefing was interrupted by Supervisor [[Lagret]], who urged Blevin to join the [[Spellhaus attack|operation]] against [[Anto Kreegyr]]. Leaving Kloris with orders to continue eavesdropping, Blevin made his way to the board room, where Lagret and Jung informed him that Kreegyr and his men were wiped out before they could take a single shot. Lagret then added that only Meero was disappointed by the lack of prisoners and that Partagaz was talking her down. ===Departure=== By [[3 BBY]], however, the chair that Blevin occupied on the ISB Board had been given to [[Avril Heert]],{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}} who had once worked as an [[ISB Attendant|attendant]] for his rival, Dedra Meero. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|You fall here, you fall alone.''"
"''Are you denying my request?''"
"''For the second time today.''"
"''Fine. I'll take it to Major Partagaz''"
"''Don't look down.|Blevin and Dedra Meero|}} [[File:ArtfulSecrets-SyrilFired.png|thumb|300px|right|Blevin was competitive and arrogant.]] Blevin was competitive with Supervisor Dedra Meero, and tried to prevent her from interfering in his investigation on the incident at Ferrix. ==Equipment== Blevin wore a white [[Imperial officer's uniform]] with two [[code cylinder]]s and a [[rank insignia plaque]] with three blue squares. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|He's an Empire guy. He's a bad guy. He's a very weaselly, slimy dude who's trying to climb the ranks at the expense of anybody and everybody else. He's that kind of guy who will stab you in the back if it means going up in the world. In the Empire, it's like the mafia, because the higher up you are, the less likely it is that you might just get whacked.|Ben Bailey Smith|{{WebCite|url=https://english.elpais.com/culture/2022-09-15/ben-bailey-smith-the-actor-who-shot-a-star-wars-series-almost-without-knowing-it-i-had-never-worked-like-this.html|text=Ben Bailey Smith, the actor who shot a 'Star Wars' series almost without knowing it: 'I had never worked like this'|date=2022-09-15|work=''[[Wikipedia:El País|El País]]''|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/F84W3|archivedate=2022-11-27}}}} [[File:Blevin.png|thumb|left|300px|Ben Bailey Smith as Blevin]] Blevin first appeared in "[[Aldhani (episode)|Aldhani]]," the fourth episode in the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of [[Tony Gilroy]]'s live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', directed by [[Susanna White]] and released on [[September 28]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-08-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} The character was portrayed by [[Ben Bailey Smith]], and appeared in the show's teaser trailer on [[May 26]] of that year.{{SWYouTube|j5UX1Adanis|Andor | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/andor-teaser-trailer}} In [[2020]], Smith did a casting for what he was lead to believe was a military drama called ''Pilgrims'', and was told that his role was "a sergeant major chewing out some soldiers." A few days later, he was told that he had gotten the job and that the project was actually ''Star Wars''. Due to studio secrecy, Smith was only given the script for his own scenes, with the context being explained to him on the shooting day. The scripts were titled ''Pilgrims'' and false names were put up on the dressing rooms. The daily production sheets were also fake. To keep drones from photographing them, the actors had to wear large cloaks when walking from their dressing room to the set. Smith struggled with the lines, which were full of sci-fi language, names of fictional [[planet]]s, and fictional laws, and did not know what the character was actually talking about. According to the actor, "One day I was delivering a line and the director came over. He's like, can we do it again with a bit more urgency? Because this planet is about to explode. And I was like, is it? I didn't know. Now I know what's going on." ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Blevin}} *{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|The Axe Forgets}} *{{Andor|The Eye}} *{{Andor|Announcement}} *{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} {{Mo}} *{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|j5UX1Adanis|Andor | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/andor-teaser-trailer}} {{1stp}} *{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-episode-4-aldhani|text="Aldhani" Episode Guide | Andor}} {{Po}} *{{SW|url=news/andor-ben-bailey-smith-interview|text=Andor's Ben Bailey Smith on Playing Lieutenant Blevin and the Fun of Being Bad}} *{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}} *{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars|cardname=Lieutenant Supervisor Blevin|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/370777/cid/22170408/2023-Topps-Star-Wars-78-Lieutenant-Supervisor-Blevin}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|dedra-meero|Dedra Meero}} *{{Databank|supervisor-blevin|Supervisor Blevin}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Blevin |fr=Blevin |ja=ブレヴィン |ka=ბლევინი |nl=Blevin |pl=Blevin}} [[Category:Coruscanti]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Security Bureau officers]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:ISB Board members]] [[Category:Males]]
